streaming_strategy.fit: load full series; <=9 configs, each ETS fit, pick min AICc.
streaming_strategy.predict: delegate to selected ETSForecaster; analytic PI.

inv.tier1_core_exception: Single-series forecasting; n<=1e6 typical; AICc selection runs up to 9 ETS fits, each needs full series. Not a fit-matrix model.
inv.purpose: AutoETS: AICc-selected ETS. Evaluates up to 9 configurations (trend N/A/Ad x season N/A/M), skips invalid combos (n<2s for seasonal; y<=0 for multiplicative), picks minimum AICc = n*ln(SSE/n) + 2k + 2k(k+1)/(n-k-1) with k = sigma+alpha+[beta]+ [gamma]+[phi]. Falls back to NaiveForecaster(last) if no config fits. Wraps ETSForecaster; same prediction interval logic.
